{{Quote|As part of her efforts to lessen infighting and streamline decision-making, Empress Acina has consolidated the Dark Council down from twelve seats to five.|[[Lana Beniko]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sphere of Scientific Advancement''' was one of the five [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was created by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. The Sphere was the combination of the Spheres of [[Sphere of Technology|Technology]] and [[Sphere of Biotic Science|Biotic Science]] and was led by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Malora]]<ref name="SOTG" /> until her removal from the position.

==History==
The Sphere of Scientific Advancement was a power base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] responsible for scientific, technological, and biotic research. It was established by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] to lessen the infighting between [[Dark Council]] members. It was one of the five seats that succeeded the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]]. The Sphere was led by [[Darth Malora]], the former apprentice to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Renning]]<ref name="SOTG" /> until she was removed from the position following the events on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. She was replaced by [[Darth Savik]].
